entries.title: Group-A against the atlas alone, the spent rehearsal
entries.what: 147 of GSE318173's healthy controls read by the one command, women against men, and a constructed 1 % neutrophil loss in half of them.
entries.outcome: Read per cell, the neutrophil row finds the planted loss; with each person's cell mix taken into account, healthy women and men read alike. A synthetic on the same 147 mixes shows the cell that changed is named when the comparison is made site by site against each cell's atlas pattern.
